# weirdfriends

> Think character.ai for language learners: weirdfriends is a free language learning app (iOS & Android) where you learn by texting AI characters with personalities, or ones you create yourself, in 24+ languages. Mistakes get underlined and explained, any message translates with a tap, and your friends can text you first throughout the day so practice feels like messaging a mate rather than doing homework.

Made by a very small team in Berlin. Website: https://weirdfriends.app

## What it does

- Chat by text with hand-picked AI characters (e.g. a Victorian ghost, a ghost pirate who haunts a mini-golf course, an alien anthropologist, a microwave in a Wichita break room).
- Create your own characters: name, emoji, a short personality description. They text you in any supported language, in character, and can be edited later.
- 24 languages: Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, Romanian, Polish, Greek, Ukrainian, Russian, Turkish, Hindi, Japanese, Chinese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Malay, English.
- Corrections with explanations: a dedicated correction model underlines mistakes; tap for the fix and a short explanation in English. Perfect messages earn +10 points.
- Tap any message for an instant English translation.
- Scenes to role-play (chaos / drama / awkward: "you won the lottery", "a cooking disaster", "we swapped bodies", "confessing a secret", "running into your ex", "blind date gets weird") or freestyle.
- Optional notifications: characters message you first during the day, in the language you're learning.
- Level setting from A1 to C2; characters adapt how they write.
- Points, streaks, stats (days practised, messages sent, year-in-chats heatmap).
- Private conversations. Dark mode.
- Text-based for now; voice is on the roadmap.

## Pricing

Free, with unlimited usage at the moment. No trial, no credit card. All languages, characters, corrections, translations, scenes and notifications are free. Paid plans are coming soon; the advice is to get in now while usage is free and unlimited.

## Positioning

Best for intermediate learners (A2/B1+) who can form sentences but freeze in real conversation. Compared with Duolingo and Babbel it has no structured curriculum and is all conversation; compared with ChatGPT it has persistent characters, automatic corrections, tap-to-translate, level awareness and proactive messages; compared with a tutor it's free, text-based and available any time. Many users combine it with a course or tutor.
